description: Cross-package pub-error proof: parse.parse_int's Result<Int, ParseError> auto-try lowers to or_throw() against the synthesized Throw, lands in a typed catch on parse.ParseError with both schema fields (e.offset, e.tag) and envelope methods (e.encode_compact()) reachable.
